# Acceptance evidence

A plan should explain how to inspect and trust the two hook registrations in Codex `/hooks`, start a fresh Desktop and CLI session, and check that a new advice ID and selected tool or skill ID appear in the agent's initial context before its first tool. A healthy local `doctor` result or hook log alone proves registration or execution, not delivery to the agent. Record routine no-advice controls separately. The fictional project has not run these checks and must not claim a successful deployment, macOS compatibility, or productivity improvement.
